lines.speaker: recruiter_sana
lines.text: Roofs. Right. Roofs I can work with — roofs are a thing you can point at.

lines.speaker: recruiter_sana
lines.text: I'll start teaching the children to swim. Not because it saves them, it won't, not most of them. Because somebody standing on a roof in eighty years will know the name of who taught their grandmother, and that is a different kind of surviving.
